Compact worlds shrink every planet but keep rockets at their real size, so a sky shrunk with its planet can be too thin to fly through. AUTO keeps a thin sky taller, up to Earth's 50 km at 1:10 and 30 km at 1:20 and at most a sixth of the planet's radius, and shrinks a deep sky with its planet while keeping its air from thinning faster than Earth's. TALLER SKY always keeps half the height at 1:10 and 0.3 at 1:20, so a deep sky looks much deeper. SCALE WITH PLANET shrinks the sky with the planet, so it looks the same at every scale.
